submission.hypothesis: Among the instruments of this panel, a ranking on one of the features below separates the next rows' returns after costs. Each ranking is a separate, simple claim; none was chosen because it looked strong: they are the rankings the scans' places did not reach.
submission.mechanism: None is claimed in advance. These are the remaining cells of a declared space (absret(), ret(10), ret(20), ret(5), ret(60), vol(20), volr(5,60); held 1, 5, 20 rows), looked at so that the space is covered and a missing result is not mistaken for a negative one.
submission.refuted_by: A book that is not positive on the check rows in both halves, or that cannot be told from the noise of every look already taken at those rows.
submission.title: The cross-sectional rankings of etf-daily no scan has looked at out of sample
submission.why_now: 14 of the 27 ranking-and-holding-period cells of this panel have no classed rule: the scans gave their places to the rankings strongest on the fit rows.
